claim_checks.claim: USI acquisition: $17.0bn gross / $16.7bn net, ~14.5x synergised TTM adj. EBITDA, debt-funded, pending
claim_checks.finding: Announced ~31-Aug-2026: $17.0bn ($16.7bn net of ~$278m tax attributes), ~14.5x synergised TTM adj. EBITDA, $395m run-rate net EBITDA synergies, accretive to adj. EPS in 2028, funded with new debt, no near-term buybacks; close expected Q4-2026. Q3-26 release: 9M debt issuance $13,404m; 'path towards deleveraging to our 2.8x-3.0x objective in approximately 24 months'. Balance sheet debt 30-Sep-26: $1,722m short-term + $26,319m long-term = $28.0bn (qual's ~$26.3bn understates by ~$1.7bn - excluded current portion). Pre-synergy multiple and ~4.5x close leverage not found in primary sources here.
